note: Cleric in a long white robe, front view. Hair and beard are head, beard bottom y~458. Collar, robe, dark belt (y~615-655) and the grey-purple cloak panel hanging beside the right hand (x650-750, y723-830) are torso. The robe hangs to y~852, so hip = robe hem y852; covered thighs get no labels, only the boots below the hem are labelled lower leg (y852-887/892) and foot (ankle at the instep, left y887, right y892). Sleeves are wide with no marked elbow, so elbows are halfway shoulder to wrist: left (image left) shoulder y~478, elbow y558, wrist y~636 where the small pale hand shows (hand y635-697) gripping the mace head; right shoulder y~480, elbow y570, wrist y655 at the dark cuff opening, pale fist y655-725. The mace head (dark ball x247-361, y598-737) is equipment, kept off the hand; its handle is hidden. The white robe and sleeves may be dropped by the foreground estimate; they are labelled by convention.
